newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's Osem cancels planned Egyptian investment.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Osem cancels planned Egyptian investment.

text.p: Osem Investment Ltd said it has cancelled plans to invest $7.5 million in an Egyptian food company.
In April, the Israeli company announced plans to buy a 50 percent stake in an unnamed Egyptian food company.
"Our decision to cancel the investment was taken totally on a commercial and not on political grounds," an Osem spokeswoman said on Wednesday.
Earlier this year Swiss giant Nestle acquired a 40 percent stake in Osem, Israel's second-largest publicly traded food company.

"Osem will continue to look for opportunities in the Arab world," said Gad Propper, president of Osem International Ltd, a subsidiary of Osem. The company already has a number of ventures abroad, including in China and India.
